def.text: Tenant; startup; business unit; business line; offering/thesis; objective
cells: Tenant; startup; business unit; business line; offering/thesis; objective
Dependent authorized selectors; omit where no relevance; aggregate read-only
Recompute scope on switch; clear old cached data
Scope selector and RLS (Part 2.4, Part 3.3); query invalidation on scope change (Part 9.6b)

Selector dependency order tenant → startup → business unit → business line → offering → objective; a selector is hidden when the screen's data model has no such dimension; on any switch the client discards every cached query keyed by the old scope **before** rendering, and the server re-derives scope from the session, never from the request body. "Offering/thesis": in this product only *offering* applies; *thesis* is investor vocabulary and is **not rendered** (CONFLICT-958)

def.text: Published brand; locale; region; authorized issuer or offering; verified session
cells: Published brand; locale; region; authorized issuer or offering; verified session
No global tenant or admin selector on public pages
Select published snapshot; enforce portal grant

Public pages read only the published snapshot for brand + locale + region; portal pages require a verified session **and** an object-level portal grant. "Authorized issuer" is investor vocabulary and is not used

def.text: Country; region; currency; timezone; language; period; owner; priority; record state
cells: Country; region; currency; timezone; language; period; owner; priority; record state
Only applicable fields; OR within multi-select, AND across fields
Persist safe filters per scoped user
Saved filters are stored per (user, tenant, startup) and exclude any value that could carry personal data (free-text search terms are not persisted)

def.text: Capability; workflow template; business objective; offering type
cells: Capability; workflow template; business objective; offering type
Remove fixed four-company lists and startup-array position restrictions
Derive permissions from approved capabilities and owned portfolio routing rules

**No code, config or permission may reference a startup by list position or by a hard-coded name**; permissions resolve from the approved capability set of the active configuration revision; static-analysis check in CI (pattern: literal startup names or `startups[0..n]` in permission code)

def.text: Channel capability; consent source; policy revision; preference; quiet hours; cap; suppression; service window
cells: Channel capability; consent source; policy revision; preference; quiet hours; cap; suppression; service window

PDP recheck at dispatch (safety invariant); consent model (Part 2.3)
Screens show *consent* (legal basis, source, timestamp) and *preference* (channel, frequency) in separate groups with separate audit events; credential fields render as references only

Use immutable revision; dedupe; reconcile unknown outcomes

Execution facts are never editable; pause / resume / retry / cancel buttons render only when the role holds the action permission **and** the run state allows the transition
